Fresh aged SHG group (real disburse + real accrual/posting/billing), parent overdue settled via real loanRepayment AUTO, child foreclosed via loanPrepayment DEFAULT->APPROVE_TASK->APPROVE. Asserts parent RSCH_LOAN_PREPAYMENT mirrors the child LOAN_PREPAYMENT leg for leg at value level: TRMN_SUSP_AMT funding equals child TRMN_AMT; every component amount and credit GL matches; each component debits termination suspense; credit GL name identifies the right ledger (BI/BP/LA/AIR/round/GST); BPI_AMT is zero on both sides (force bill covers the whole broken period); termination suspense is fully drawn; double entry balances. Proven red on pre-fix postings 1871988/1871989 where the parent posted 5021.52 of 22385 with unbilled principal, penal and round-off missing. Also audits the non-GL writes: member and account status CLOSED, dues and installments fully settled, closure row present and not reversed, member and group payment rows with exact principal/interest split (member settles its own billed principal on top of balance principal; the group reschedules on balance principal alone), group part-prepayment row DEPOSITED with net equal to the member balance principal, and the group loan still ACTIVE.

foreclosure.fc_on_emi_due_date.note: TDPQA-240. Fresh INDL loan disbursed 60 days back with its first EMI TODAY (loanPrepayment rejects any foreclosure_date != system date with 132282, so the EMI must fall on today), aged by the real interestAccrualCalculation -> interestAccrualPosting -> loanAccountBillingJob chain, then foreclosed by real loanPrepayment DEFAULT -> APPROVE_TASK -> APPROVE. Preconditions fail closed: the EMI billing must have swept a NON-ZERO accrual whole (accrued == billed > 0 on the foreclosure installment) and the newest accrual period must end on the foreclosure date - 0/0 is not the reported shape and must not pass. The defect assert is the labd ROW COUNT on that installment across FC approve: force-bill must add none. Proven red on pre-fix accounting (INDL 6004175525, labd 1 -> 2, an extra 62.00 billed on a cycle already billed 1229.00) and green with the fix (INDL 6004175625, labd 1 -> 1, INT_AMT credited 1229.00 == billed interest charged 1229.00). NOTE: termination suspense nets to 0.00 locally on BOTH builds - the QA4 suspense residue is a downstream consequence, so an amount-only or GL-only assert does NOT catch this class. Local fixture prerequisites (see cursor-bundle/memory/feedback_local_disburse_gst_simulator_block.md): price_setup.tax_group_id must be NULL for the fee codes or disburse dies on the GST simulator 500, and DISBURSE_ENTRY=http skips the LOS preflight.

foreclosure.last_child_parent_closure.note: TDPQA-72. Fresh aged 3-member SHG group (real disburse + real accrual/posting/billing). Members 1 and 2 foreclose on the SAME date: proves the group force-bill client reference carries the originating member as discriminator, so the second member is not rejected as a duplicate (134497) and is not stranded in FORECLOSURE_FREEZE. Member 3 is the last remaining member: the group must close instead of rescheduling. Before the fix parentLoanAccountPartPrepayment still regenerated the schedule and EquatedRepaymentScheduleGenerator threw 134203 (installmentAmount <= roundedInterestAmount) with no principal left, leaving the member in FORECLOSURE_FREEZE and the group in FORECLOSURE_FREEZE_RSCH. Asserts value-level: the group still posts its RSCH_LOAN_PREPAYMENT mirror (one per closed member, not skipped with the reschedule), the group nets to zero open principal with dues SETTLED as paid and installments settled (foreclosure semantics, not the cancellation path which soft-deletes them), group loan and account CLOSED with a closing date, and no reschedule left PENDING against a closed loan. Non-last members keep their existing contract: parent stays ACTIVE and reschedules.
